title: Natural Earth I with Shaded Relief
description: Satellite-derived land-cover colors and geographic shaded relief; contextual basemap, not CarbonGlobe simulation values.

georeferencing.orientation: North at top; longitude increases left to right; -180 degrees at left edge; 0 degrees at center; +180 degrees at right edge.
georeferencing.pixelSampling: Pixel centers; latitude = 90 - (y + 0.5) * 180 / height; longitude = -180 + (x + 0.5) * 360 / width.

colorAdjustment.scope: Identical adjustment for every pixel, without geographic or land-cover classification

processing.note: No synthetic land classes, latitude-based recoloring, added snow, or generative imagery.

displayNotes: The natural-color terrain is geographic context and must remain distinguishable from the simulated ecosystem overlay.
This variant has an uncolored ocean background; use the renderer's geographic land mask to retain the fixed blue ocean.
Shaded relief is already baked into the raster. Snow/ice, deserts, vegetation, and mountain colors come from the Natural Earth source.
